speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are a pregnant patient experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To better assess your condition, how many weeks pregnant are you, and when did these symptoms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. The ice cream consumption is an interesting detail. Given your 30-week gestation and the sudden onset of fever with headache, do you have a known tick exposure, and have you noticed any rash, particularly around your wrists or ankles?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria Monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The consumption of unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream) three days prior to symptom onset, combined with your 30-week pregnancy and flu-like symptoms including fever, headache, and anorexia, is highly suggestive of this specific pathogen. I will now request blood cultures to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: Blood Culture
